[If the payee didn't claim the tax-free threshold](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/payg-withholding-schedule-1-statement-of-formulas-for-calculating-amounts-to-be-withheld/coefficients-to-use-in-formulas-for-withholding-from-weekly-payments#ato-Ifthepayeedidntclaimthetaxfreethreshold) - [If the payee didn't give a TFN](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/payg-withholding-schedule-1-statement-of-formulas-for-calculating-amounts-to-be-withheld/coefficients-to-use-in-formulas-for-withholding-from-weekly-payments#ato-IfthepayeedidntgiveaTFN) - [If the payee claims an exemption from Medicare levy](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/payg-withholding-schedule-1-statement-of-formulas-for-calculating-amounts-to-be-withheld/coefficients-to-use-in-formulas-for-withholding-from-weekly-payments#ato-IfthepayeeclaimsanexemptionfromMedicarelevy) - [Notes on using the scales](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/payg-withholding-schedule-1-statement-of-formulas-for-calculating-amounts-to-be-withheld/coefficients-to-use-in-formulas-for-withholding-from-weekly-payments#ato-Notesonusingthescales) ## If the payee didn't claim the tax-free threshold | Weekly earnings

$1 & over | 0.4500 | If a tax file number (TFN) was not provided by the payee– Scale 4 ## If the payee claims an exemption from Medicare levy ### Full exemption | Weekly earnings
(x) | a | b | | --- | --- | --- | | Less than $362 | – | – | | Less than $721 | 0.1500 | 54.3462 | | Less than $865 | 0.1590 | 60.8365 | | Less than $1,282 | 0.3027 | 185.1923 | | Less than $2,596 | 0.3000 | 181.7308 | | Less than $3,653 | 0.3700 | 363.4615 | | $3,653 & over | 0.4500 | 655.7692 | If the payee claimed the full exemption from Medicare levy in _Medicare levy variation declaration_ – Scale 5 ### Half exemption | Weekly earnings
(x) | a | b | | --- | --- | --- | | Less than $362 | – | – | | Less than $721 | 0.1500 | 54.3462 | | Less than $865 | 0.1590 | 60.8365 | | Less than $908 | 0.3027 | 185.1923 | | Less than $1,135 | 0.3527 | 230.6135 | | Less than $1,282 | 0.3127 | 185.1923 | | Less than $2,596 | 0.3100 | 181.7308 | | Less than $3,653 | 0.3800 | 363.4615 | | $3,653 & over | 0.4600 | 655.7692 | If the payee claimed a half exemption from Medicare levy in _Medicare levy variation declaration_ – Scale 6 ## Notes on using the scales ### 27 fortnightly, or 53 weekly pays in the year If you have 27 fortnightly or 53 weekly pays in a financial year, refer to [When there are 27 and 53 pays](https://www.ato.gov.au/tax-rates-and-codes/payg-withholding-schedule-1-statement-of-formulas-for-calculating-amounts-to-be-withheld/using-a-formula#Roundingofwithholdingamounts) in a financial year. ### Using different scales - Scales 1, 2, 3, 5 and 6 may be applied only if payees have provided their TFN. - For scale 4, no coefficients are necessary. To calculate withholding, apply the tax rate to earnings, ignoring any cents in earnings and in the withholding result. - Scales 1 and 2 apply whether or not the payee is entitled to any leave loading. - Tax offsets may be allowed only where scales 2, 5 or 6 are applied. - Scales 1, 2, 4 and 6 incorporate the Medicare levy. Scale 4 incorporates the Medicare levy for resident payees only. - For scale 2, no Medicare levy is payable by a person whose taxable income for the year is $28,011 ($538 per week) or less. If the taxable income exceeds $28,011 but is less than $35,013 ($673 per week), the levy is shaded in at the rate of 10% of the excess over $28,011 . If a person’s taxable income is $35,013 ($673 per week) or more, Medicare is levied at the rate of 2% of total taxable income. - The Medicare levy is also shaded in for scale 6.
